panels.title: How to read this dashboard

options.content:
This dashboard shows **current size and growth over time** from existing collectors. It covers scraped ext4/XFS filesystems on nodes running node-exporter, each node/device counted once.

**Per-disk attribution** comes from the `disk_usage:*` recording rules (`cluster/cdk8s/monitoring/rules.py`). Each component reports its own bytes and is placed on a disk through its pod's PVC host path: SeaweedFS volume files per collection (one series per replica, on the disk holding it), SeaweedFS bytes deleted but not yet vacuumed, ClickHouse MergeTree parts, CNPG database files on PGDATA (no WAL), and PVCs that kubelet measures. Unattributed is filesystem used (size minus free) minus those components: container images, emptyDir volumes, logs, etcd, node-local PVCs whose owner exports no size, and collector skew. Reserved is ext4's root-only reserve (free minus available). Media is the kernel's rotational flag; virtual disks report rotational whatever backs them, so they show as `virtual`.

Lower sections are per-collector detail. SeaweedFS bucket logical bytes omit replicas; physical bucket bytes and collection bytes mostly measure the same replicated data. Do not add the detailed charts together. Missing samples do not imply zero use.

**Machine selector:** Filters node-owned filesystem panels and collector details. SeaweedFS S3 bucket panels are cluster-wide because the metrics do not identify storage-node ownership, so the selector does not apply to them. Piraeus thin-pool accounting and per-volume allocation are not supported in this dashboard yet; they will be added with the native accounting rules.

panels.title: Selected node filesystems: data used
panels.description: Sum of ext4/XFS size minus free bytes across selected machines, deduplicated by node and device. This excludes ext4 root-reserved blocks.

targets.expr: sum(max by (node, device) (max by (node, device, mountpoint) ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs",device!=""} - node_filesystem_free_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs",device!=""}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))))

panels.title: Selected node filesystem capacity
panels.description: Total ext4/XFS filesystem capacity across selected machines, deduplicated by node and device.

targets.expr: sum(max by (node, device) (max by (node, device, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs",device!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))))

panels.title: Scraped disk capacity by use on selected machines
panels.description: Existing ext4/XFS filesystem attribution for selected machines. Reserved is ext4 root-only reserve; Piraeus pool and per-volume accounting are not included yet.

targets.expr: sum by (category) (disk_usage:component_used_bytes{node=~"$node"})
sum(disk_usage:unattributed_bytes{node=~"$node"})
sum(disk_usage:filesystem_free_bytes{node=~"$node"} - on (node, device) disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"})
sum(disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Selected machines · ext4/XFS filesystem attribution
Node filesystems by component
panels.description: One bar per node and filesystem device; disk labels include node, device, mountpoint, and media.

targets.expr: label_join((sum by (node, device, component) (disk_usage:component_used_bytes{node=~"$node"}) or label_replace(disk_usage:unattributed_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Unattributed", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_free_bytes{node=~"$node"} - disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Reserved (root only)", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Free", "", "")) * on (node, device) group_left (mountpoint, media) (topk by (node, device) (1, disk_usage:mount:info{node=~"$node"}) * on (node, device) group_left (media) disk_usage:filesystem:info{node=~"$node"}), "disk", " · ", "node", "device", "mountpoint", "media")
max(disk_usage:filesystem_size_bytes{node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Detail
Per-disk attribution across selected machines
panels.description: Filesystem component, unattributed, reserved, and free bytes per node and disk. Values are attributed through the existing component rules.

targets.expr: sort_desc((sum by (node, device, component) (disk_usage:component_used_bytes{node=~"$node"}) or label_replace(disk_usage:unattributed_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Unattributed", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_free_bytes{node=~"$node"} - disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Reserved (root only)", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Free", "", "")) * on (node, device) group_left (mountpoint, media) (topk by (node, device) (1, disk_usage:mount:info{node=~"$node"}) * on (node, device) group_left (media) disk_usage:filesystem:info{node=~"$node"}))

(sum by (node, device, component) (disk_usage:component_used_bytes{node=~"$node"}) or label_replace(disk_usage:unattributed_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Unattributed", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_free_bytes{node=~"$node"} - disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Reserved (root only)", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Free", "", "")) * on (node, device) group_left (mountpoint, media) (topk by (node, device) (1, disk_usage:mount:info{node=~"$node"}) * on (node, device) group_left (media) disk_usage:filesystem:info{node=~"$node"}) / on (node, device) group_left () disk_usage:filesystem_size_bytes{node=~"$node"}

panels.title: Unattributed bytes per disk on selected machines
panels.description: Filesystem used (size minus free) minus every attributed component. On system disks (/var, /) this is mostly container images, emptyDir volumes, logs and etcd, which no scraped metric breaks down; on data disks, see the PVC list beside it.

targets.expr: sort_desc(label_join(disk_usage:unattributed_bytes{node=~"$node"} * on (node, device) group_left (mountpoint, media) (topk by (node, device) (1, disk_usage:mount:info{node=~"$node"}) * on (node, device) group_left (media) disk_usage:filesystem:info{node=~"$node"}), "disk", " · ", "node", "device", "mountpoint", "media"))

panels.title: Node-local PVCs without usage metrics on selected machines
panels.description: PVCs visible in the existing node-local filesystem mapping but without a matching component-size sample. This is an ext4/XFS mapping detail, separate from Piraeus copy allocation and kubelet PVC use below.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (node, device, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (disk_usage:pvc_filesystem:info{node=~"$node"} unless on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) disk_usage:component_used_bytes{node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left () max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_resource_requests_storage_bytes))

panels.title: Node filesystem used now
panels.description: Ext4/XFS size minus filesystem free bytes on selected machines. Free includes root-reserved blocks, so used bytes exclude that reserve.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (node, device, mountpoint) ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs",device!=""} - node_filesystem_free_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs",device!=""}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: Largest node filesystems over time
panels.description: Top ten ext4/XFS mounts by size minus free bytes across selected machines. Free includes root-reserved blocks, so used bytes exclude that reserve.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (node, device, mountpoint) ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs",device!=""} - node_filesystem_free_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs",device!=""}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: CNPG database size by machine now
panels.description: CNPG exporter database-size values from pods on the selected machine. This database metric is not total PGDATA filesystem use; replicas report their own copies and must not be added across machines as unique data.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (node, namespace, job, datname) (cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes{datname!~"template0|template1"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: Largest CNPG databases by machine over time
panels.description: CNPG exporter database-size values from pods on the selected machine. This database metric is not total PGDATA filesystem use; replicas report their own copies and must not be added across machines as unique data.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (node, namespace, job, datname) (cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes{datname!~"template0|template1"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: SeaweedFS volume-server disks by machine now
panels.description: Volume-server all/available/used resource gauges from pods on the selected machine. These per-server values are collector detail and are not additive to the filesystem or Piraeus pool totals.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (node, pod, name, type) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_resource{namespace="seaweedfs",type=~"all|avail|used"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: SeaweedFS volume-server disk use by machine over time
panels.description: Volume-server reported used bytes per selected storage node and server disk. This is a per-collector view; do not add it to the independent pool and filesystem accounting layers.

targets.expr: max by (node, pod, name) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_resource{namespace="seaweedfs",type="used"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: SeaweedFS S3 logical bucket size now (cluster-wide)
panels.description: Logical object bytes by bucket across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (bucket) (SeaweedFS_s3_bucket_size_bytes{namespace="seaweedfs",bucket!=""}))

panels.title: Largest SeaweedFS S3 logical buckets over time (cluster-wide)
panels.description: Top ten logical object buckets across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (bucket) (SeaweedFS_s3_bucket_size_bytes{namespace="seaweedfs",bucket!=""}))

panels.title: SeaweedFS S3 physical bucket size now (cluster-wide)
panels.description: S3-reported physical bucket bytes across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (bucket) (SeaweedFS_s3_bucket_physical_size_bytes{namespace="seaweedfs",bucket!=""}))

panels.title: Largest SeaweedFS S3 physical buckets over time (cluster-wide)
panels.description: Top ten S3-reported physical buckets across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership; these bytes overlap collection-level replica bytes.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (bucket) (SeaweedFS_s3_bucket_physical_size_bytes{namespace="seaweedfs",bucket!=""}))

panels.title: SeaweedFS collection bytes by machine now
panels.description: Collection bytes reported by volume-server pods on the selected machine. Each replica is counted on its storage node; these collector values overlap physical bucket bytes.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (node, collection) (max by (node, collection, pod) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_total_disk_size{namespace="seaweedfs",type="normal",collection!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"}))))

panels.title: Largest SeaweedFS collections by machine over time
panels.description: Collection bytes reported by volume-server pods on the selected machine over time. Each replica is counted on its storage node; these collector values overlap physical bucket bytes.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (node, collection) (max by (node, collection, pod) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_total_disk_size{namespace="seaweedfs",type="normal",collection!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"}))))

panels.title: ClickHouse MergeTree bytes by machine now
panels.description: MergeTree bytes reported by ClickHouse pods on the selected machine, including the existing system-table metric. This per-pod collector detail is separate from host filesystem and Piraeus pool use.

targets.expr: sort_desc((max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTables{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"})) + max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTablesSystem{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"}))))

panels.title: ClickHouse MergeTree bytes by machine over time
panels.description: MergeTree bytes reported by ClickHouse pods on the selected machine, including the existing system-table metric. This per-pod collector detail is separate from host filesystem and Piraeus pool use.

targets.expr: (max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTables{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"})) + max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTablesSystem{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"})))
